title_sq: SHITET ZYRE BUZE RRUGES SE KAVAJES!
description_sq:
Ofrohet zyre per shitje shume prane qendres se Tiranes.
Ndodhet ne katin e pare te nje godine te re me hyrje te dedikuar vetem per biznesin.
Zyra ka nje fasade te madhe prej 15 metrash qe shikon rrugen kryesore, e ndare ne tre fasada te medha xhami, duke rritur ndjeshem vizibilitetin e shenjave dalluese te cdo biznesi.
Shtrihet ne nje siperfaqe prej 131 metrash katror neto dhe mund te sherbeje per disa lloje aktivitetesh, si klinika dentare, mjeksore, zyra te tipologjive te ndryshme pasi ka dukshmeri te larte per klientet ne nje artiere me kalueshmeri te larte, si ajo e rruges se Kavajes.
Prona disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor dhe eshte njesi te certifikate.
Aktualisht eshte e dhene me qera dhe eshte e gatshme per tu vizituar pas muajit maj.
Per me shume informacion jeni te lutur te na kontaktoni.

title_en: OFFICE FOR SALE ON THE SIDE OF KAVAJA STREET!
description_en: An office is offered for sale very close to the center of Tirana. It is located on the first floor of a new building with an entrance dedicated only to business. The office has a large facade of 15 meters that overlooks the main street, divided into three large glass facades, significantly increasing the visibility of the distinctive signs of each business. It covers an area of ​​131 net square meters and can be used for several types of activities, such as dental clinics, medical clinics, offices of various typologies as it has high visibility for customers in a high-traffic street, such as Kavaje Street. The property has regular mortgage documentation and is a certified unit. It is currently rented and is ready to be visited after May. For more information, please contact us. IRG136595
